records.jp: お疲れ様、愛央
records.en_original: How are you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: How are you, Ao?
records.en: Good work, Ao.

records.jp: ……美弦さんも
records.en_original: Hey, Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Mio...
records.en: ...Mio-san, you too.

records.jp: クラックのこと、気にしてるの？
records.en_original: Are you worried about the Crack?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you worried about the Crack?
records.en: Are you worried about the Crack?

records.jp: そりゃあ、そうだよ。<CR>私が決断して、こうなっちゃったわけだし……
records.en_original: Well, yeah. It's kinda my fault it happened...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, yeah. It's kinda my fault it happened...
records.en: Of course I am.<CR>I made the decision that led to this...

records.jp: やっぱり私、間違ってたのかな？<CR>もう、何が正解か分かんないよ……
records.en_original: Did I make a mistake? I just don't know anymore...
records.en_auxiliary: Did I make a mistake? I just don't know anymore...
records.en: Was I wrong after all?<CR>I no longer know what the right answer is...

records.jp: そうやって一人でぐるぐる考えてるときって、<CR>たいていの場合はいい方向に進まないわ
records.en_original: Brooding over things by yourself usually isn't the best way to make progress.
records.en_auxiliary: Brooding over things by yourself usually isn't the best way to make progress.
records.en: When you keep going in circles alone like that,<CR>things rarely move in a good direction.

records.jp: 私も昔そうだったから、なんとなく分かる
records.en_original: I used to do the same, so I know how it goes.
records.en_auxiliary: I used to do the same, so I know how it goes.
records.en: I used to do the same, so I know how it goes.

records.jp: 美弦さんが……？
records.en_original: You did?
records.en_auxiliary: You did?
records.en: You did, Mio-san?

records.jp: ええ
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 私は陽桜莉とそれほど喧嘩しないけど、<CR>そのことに関してはよく衝突してた
records.en_original: Hiori and I never fought very often, but we did disagree quite a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori and I never fought very often, but we did disagree quite a lot.
records.en: Hiori and I do not fight very often, but we<CR>used to clash over that particular issue.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんは一人で考えすぎだ。<CR>もっと私にも相談して……ってね
records.en_original: She always told me that I thought about things alone too much―that I should talk with her more.
records.en_auxiliary: She always told me that I thought about things alone too much―that I should talk with her more.
records.en: “You think too much on your own, Onee-chan.<CR>Talk to me more...” That is what she would tell me.

records.jp: ……確かに、陽桜莉さんそういうこと言いそう
records.en_original: That definitely sounds like Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: That definitely sounds like Hiori...
records.en: That definitely sounds like Hiori-san...

records.jp: でしょう？
records.en_original: Doesn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't it?
records.en: Doesn't it?

records.jp: 一人で何でもかんでも解決しようなんてのは、<CR>きっと傲慢なのよ
records.en_original: It was selfish of me to try and solve everything on my own.
records.en_auxiliary: It was selfish of me to try and solve everything on my own.
records.en: Trying to solve absolutely everything alone is surely<CR>a form of arrogance.

records.jp: 今でも、意識していないと<CR>悩みの螺旋に囚われてしまう
records.en_original: Even now I've caught myself starting to spiral again into that vortex of worry.
records.en_auxiliary: Even now I've caught myself starting to spiral again into that vortex of worry.
records.en: Even now, if I am not careful,<CR>I become trapped in a spiral of worry.

records.jp: 人に悩みを打ち明けるのは思ったより難しい。<CR>自分の弱さをさらけ出すのと同じようなものだから
records.en_original: It's not easy to share your struggles with another person. It's like laying out your weaknesses for them to see.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not easy to share your struggles with another person. It's like laying out your weaknesses for them to see.
records.en: It's not easy to share your struggles with another person.<CR>It's like laying out your weaknesses for them to see.

records.jp: そう……だね。私も、力不足だと思われるのが嫌で、<CR>一人でどうにかしなきゃって考えてた……
records.en_original: Yeah... I think I know what you mean. I was so worried about everyone thinking I was weak, I tried to do everything myself.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I think I know what you mean. I was so worried about everyone thinking I was weak, I tried to do everything myself.
records.en: ...Yes. I hated the thought that everyone might see me as inadequate,<CR>so I believed I had to handle everything alone...

records.jp: 貢献のしかた、というのは一つじゃないわ
records.en_original: There's more than one way to help people.
records.en_auxiliary: There's more than one way to help people.
records.en: There is more than one way to contribute.

records.jp: みんなの真ん中で「大丈夫」「なんとかなる」って、<CR>笑ってるだけでも力になることはある
records.en_original: Sometimes all people need is someone to tell them that everything will be all right.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes all people need is someone to tell them that everything will be all right.
records.en: Simply standing in the middle of everyone, smiling and saying, "It will be all<CR>right" or "We will manage," can give people strength.

records.jp: 私はそういう役割は担えない。<CR>つまり、適材適所ってことよ
records.en_original: But I can't be that. You're the only one who can do that for everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: But I can't be that. You're the only one who can do that for everyone.
records.en: I cannot fill that role. In other words, it is a matter<CR>of putting the right person in the right place.

records.jp: ……そういうもの、なのかな
records.en_original: You...think so?
records.en_auxiliary: You...think so?
records.en: Is that how it works...?

records.jp: それでも不安なら、みんなに相談してみればいいわ。<CR>きっと、同じようなことを言うと思うけどね
records.en_original: Still, if you're ever worried about something, you should talk with us. I'm sure the others would say the same.
records.en_auxiliary: Still, if you're ever worried about something, you should talk with us. I'm sure the others would say the same.
records.en: If you are still uneasy, try discussing it with everyone.<CR>I am sure they will tell you something similar.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah, I know.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah, I know.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: ありがとう、美弦さん。<CR>私も、私にできることで、頑張ろうと思う
records.en_original: Thanks, Mio. I'll do my best.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Mio. I'll do my best.
records.en: Thank you, Mio-san.<CR>I will do my best in the way that I can.

records.jp: 私、いろいろ抱え込んじゃってたんだね
records.en_original: I guess I tried to take on a bit too much by myself, huh.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I tried to take on a bit too much by myself, huh.
records.en: I guess I tried to take on a bit too much by myself, huh.

records.jp: ええ、そうかもしれない
records.en_original: Yes, so it seems.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, so it seems.
records.en: Yes, so it seems.

records.jp: だから……お互い、気になったことや<CR>困ったことがあったら話し合いましょう
records.en_original: That's why you should talk with us about the things bothering you.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why you should talk with us about the things bothering you.
records.en: So... whenever either of us notices something<CR>or has a problem, let us talk it through.

records.jp: いつ相談に来てくれてもいいわ。<CR>その代わり、私も相談に行かせてもらうから
records.en_original: I'm happy to lend an ear anytime. Though I expect you to do the same for me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm happy to lend an ear anytime. Though I expect you to do the same for me.
records.en: You may come to me for advice at any time.<CR>In return, I will come to you as well.

records.jp: ……うん！　また何かあったら、お話するね
records.en_original: ...Yeah! I'll be sure to talk with you if there's ever something.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah! I'll be sure to talk with you if there's ever something.
records.en: ...Yeah! I'll talk to you again if something happens.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>分かち合う弱さ<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>The Weakness to Share<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>The Weakness to Share<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>The Weakness to Share<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
